studies.notes: Checked the entire markdown conversion of the saved arXiv v2 paper, PDF figure labels and notes, and Appendices A and B (PDF pp. 16-18). n_randomized records the printed recruited cohort, also shown entering the randomization flow in Figure 2 (PDF p. 4). No analyzed participant total, per-arm headcount, or exclusion headcount is printed for the main unassisted originality analysis or the other creativity analyses. Section 3.2 (PDF p. 6) states: "We report on the analysis of 9,457 ideas generated by participants across all conditions and phases." This counts ideas, not people. The flow diagram gives allocation percentages only; neither those percentages nor the diversity analysis's sampled ideas were converted to participant counts. The appendices contain prompts, model settings and example responses, with no further participant counts. The linked preregistration https://aspredicted.org/dkvp-n785.pdf was requested with urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 but could not be read because socket access was blocked (WinError 10013).
